en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up of the pediment and upper façade of a grand historic theater building. The triangular pediment is filled with a classical relief sculpture depicting a reclining lion and mythological human figures, one raising an arm and holding a bow. Beneath the pediment, large serif lettering on the entablature reads "MAGYAR NEMZETI SZINHÁZ." The stone surface appears weathered, emphasizing the age of the structure.
